testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (button, input, select, link, tab, accordion, modal trigger) MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all existing content, functionality, data flow, and section components in src/components/ home page.
Elevate the visual design using generous spacing (py-20 md:py-32), crisp borders, backdrop blur, refined shadows, and Framer Motion staggered reveals.
Maintain high APCA text contrast in light theme. Ensure dropdowns and overlays have solid or glass backgrounds, never completely transparent.
Strictly follow data-testid attribute preservation and creation for test stability.
Apply Outfit font for H1-H3 headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness with single-column collapse, mobile bottom nav, and max-h-[70vh] image caps on smaller viewports.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid default centered generic layouts; create asymmetrical bento grids and layered visual depth.
Use backdrop-blur-xl and glassmorphism effects for sticky navigation and search filters.
Do NOT apply universal transitions like transition: all; target explicit properties like opacity, transform, background-color.
Ensure all interactive buttons have explicit hover and active states with matching text contrast.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters as icons; use Lucide-react or Radix icons.
